method: bend/bifurcation angles measured in the atlas RMF and transported along the centreline; upstream windows walk the root-ward segment chain; Murray split uses distal radii^3; capfit split (v1.2) = train138-fitted log(Q_ext/Q_int) = a log((r_cap_ext/r_cap_int)^2) + b on the geometry-program cap radii, root/common-iliac shares stay protocol; v1.3 log_r_over_rdistal = ln(R_local / R_distal(segment)) with the Murray distal-radius recipe (median atlas radius over the distal 10 mm of the point's segment); population prior = mean ln(WSS_peak, floor 0.05 Pa) per (semantic, s/L x20, theta x12) bin over train138, leave-one-out for train cases
